source_name: NBU — Інформація про керівників банків (Bank Managers information page/registry)
why_relevant: Statutory NBU-maintained listing of bank managers (surname, position, bank, period of service). This is the single most authoritative structured layer for Ukrainian bank leadership changes; deltas between snapshots directly yield leadership-move events.

source_name: NBU newsroom — Новини / all news (press releases incl. approvals of bank executives)
why_relevant: NBU publishes press releases when it completes fit-and-proper review or approves supervisory-board / management-board members (e.g. state banks). Primary narrative source for individual appointment events.

source_name: NBU archive-news (older press releases, incl. NBU's own Council/Board appointments)
why_relevant: Backfill layer for historical leadership-move baseline (e.g. appointment of the Chairman of the NBU Council); needed to build person-level career histories.

source_name: NBU — Ліцензування небанківських установ / ліцензії на фінансові платіжні послуги
why_relevant: Under the Law on Payment Services the NBU authorises payment institutions and assesses business reputation and professional suitability of their managers, chief accountants and key-function holders. Licensing decisions signal new payment-market entrants and their leadership.

source_name: NBU — Реєстрація платіжних систем, учасників та технологічних операторів (Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури, РПІ)
why_relevant: Register of payment infrastructure entities; entity-level roster whose entries can be joined with EDR director data to detect leadership/org changes among payment providers.

source_name: NBU — Пошук небанківських установ / registers & lists (non-bank institutions)
why_relevant: Searchable registry surface for non-bank financial and payment institutions supervised by the NBU after 'split'; source of entity universe for payments-side leadership tracking.

source_name: Портал відкритих даних data.gov.ua — розпорядник «Національний банк України»
why_relevant: Machine-readable mirror/dataset catalogue of NBU-held datasets (including the registry-of-datasets and NBU normative acts), giving a stable, less bot-defended access path than bank.gov.ua HTML.

source_name: zakon.rada.gov.ua — NBU normative acts and resolutions (Положення про ліцензування, Положення про авторизацію)
why_relevant: Authoritative legal text defining fit-and-proper / business-reputation criteria and the approval procedure for bank and payment-provider managers. Needed to interpret and structure appointment signals, and rule changes are themselves regulatory-shift signals.

source_name: НКЦПФР — Загальнодоступна інформаційна база даних про ринок цінних паперів (stockmarket.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Issuers (including banks that are joint-stock companies) must file 'особлива інформація' on any change in the composition of officials — date, position, name. This is a structured, legally mandated, near-real-time leadership-change feed independent of the NBU.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — новини та конкурсні відбори до наглядових рад держбанків
why_relevant: MoF, as shareholder of Oschadbank/Ukreximbank/PrivatBank/Sense Bank, announces competitive selections and formation of management/supervisory boards — often the earliest official signal, ahead of NBU approval.

source_name: Кабінет Міністрів України — рішення про призначення наглядових рад держбанків
why_relevant: The Cabinet formally appoints supervisory-board members of state banks and approves the selection procedure (Порядок обрання членів наглядових рад державних банків); its acts are the legal record of the appointment.

source_name: Комітет ВРУ з питань фінансів, податкової та митної політики
why_relevant: Parliamentary finance committee announces competitive selections for state-bank supervisory boards and handles the NBU Governor/Council appointment track; also runs investigative commissions touching NBU governance.

source_name: Офіційне інтернет-представництво Президента України (укази/подання щодо Голови НБУ)
why_relevant: By law the President submits the NBU Governor candidacy to the Rada and appoints/dismisses part of the NBU Council; presidential decrees are the primary record for the very top of the regulator.

source_name: Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб (ФГВФО)
why_relevant: State resolution authority: appoints authorised persons (уповноважені особи Фонду) over insolvent banks — a distinct class of forced leadership change — and publishes its own governance/appointment news.

source_name: Єдиний державний реєстр (ЄДР) via Opendatabot
why_relevant: Commercial monitoring layer over the Unified State Register: alerts on change of a legal entity's director/signatories. Detects de-jure leadership changes at banks and payment companies, often before or independently of press coverage.

source_name: YouControl
why_relevant: Company-dossier platform aggregating EDR, licences, sanctions, connections; useful for resolving a newly appointed executive to prior roles and for building person-level career graphs.

source_name: Clarity Project
why_relevant: Free analytical platform over Ukrainian state registers and procurement; usable as a low-cost cross-check on entity officers and affiliations for banks and payment companies.

source_name: Фінансовий клуб (FinClub)
why_relevant: Specialist Ukrainian banking/finance outlet that reports NBU fit-and-proper hearings, board elections and approvals in detail, including bank-by-bank profile pages. Fast interpretive layer over regulator actions.

source_name: Мінфін (minfin.com.ua) — банківські новини та теги
why_relevant: High-volume Ukrainian financial portal with a dedicated banks tag; reliably covers NBU approvals, board changes and supervisory-board appointments with dates and names.

source_name: Інтерфакс-Україна (interfax.com.ua) — economic wire
why_relevant: News agency wire that reports formation of bank management boards and regulator decisions quickly and with attribution; useful for timestamping events.

source_name: LB.ua / NV Бізнес — coverage of NBU qualification commissions and fit-and-proper hearings
why_relevant: General-interest outlets that nonetheless report NBU кваліфікаційна комісія hearings on professional suitability of sitting bank chairs — an early-warning signal of contested or forced leadership change.

source_name: zib.com.ua / dtkt.ua / ligazakon — legal-trade commentary on NBU personnel-approval rule changes
why_relevant: Legal trade press explains changes to the NBU procedure for approving bank managers (document packages, nostrification requirements, acting-manager rules) — context needed to interpret volume shifts in approvals.

source_name: Babel / Ukrinform (English + Ukrainian) — appointment reporting
why_relevant: English-language restatement of NBU approvals (e.g. Ukreximbank board chairman) and government appointments; useful for entity-name normalisation between uk and en transliterations.

source_name: Ministry of Finance — dedicated competitive-selection announcement pages for a named bank
why_relevant: The legally required 'оголошення про проведення конкурсного відбору' for a specific state bank — carries the vacancy count, candidate requirements, deadline and the commission. This is the earliest datable signal of an upcoming board turnover, typically months before the appointment. A parallel page type announces the tender for the executive-search (headhunting) firm.

source_name: Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine — official portal news and NPA section (Кабмін, kmu.gov.ua)
why_relevant: The Cabinet is the body that legally appoints and terminates state-bank supervisory board members, and the law requires the competition announcement to be published on the Cabinet's official site. Found: 'Мінфін: Рішенням Уряду вдосконалено процедури відбору незалежних членів наглядових рад державних банків' (procedure amendments published 2 March 2026) and the base act 'Про затвердження Порядку обрання членів наглядових рад державних банків'.

source_name: zakon.rada.gov.ua — legislation database (Cabinet resolutions and розпорядження on bank governance)
why_relevant: Authoritative full text and consolidated versions of the acts that actually enact appointments/dismissals and change the selection commission — e.g. 'Про внесення змін до складу конкурсної комісії з визначення претендентів на посади незалежних членів наглядової ради державного банку' (розпорядження 1081-2024-р). Gives exact dates, names and act numbers for a leadership-change timeline.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine — news on approval of bank managers (НБУ, погодження керівників)
why_relevant: No supervisory-board member or management-board chair takes office until the NBU completes the fit-and-proper review. NBU publishes items such as 'Національний банк завершив розгляд кандидатур нових членів наглядової ради Ощадбанку'. This is the confirmation step that converts a political appointment into an effective one, and NBU refusal is itself a strong signal.
